verdict.rationale: Extend documents a first-party evaluation system: evaluation sets that score a pinned processor version against labeled items and return aggregate metrics. The 10k free credits with no contract, plus isolated test-mode API keys, let an engineer run their own evals before committing. However, the only vendor accuracy statement is the marketing claim of "unmatched accuracy," with no published, reproducible benchmark. Missing for 10: published reproducible accuracy benchmarks (datasets, methodology, scores), independent or hands-on corroboration of eval workflows.
